comment: Epoch 63 of 1.2.2, EU5 1.4.7/build26377361; frozen epoch62 preserved in golden_world_epoch62.json. 1.2.2 cuts the New World's subcontinents at the waist of a landmass, by a minimum cut in a window of latitudes around the vanilla share (scanned over several latitudes for the size nearest it), where 1.2.0 and 1.2.1 cut them along a row, which sliced islands in two; a subcontinent may hold two pieces of one landmass when each can hold a region. Regions, areas and provinces are made from the new subcontinents. The location raster, the hierarchy, its localization in all eleven languages and the scripts that name it change; the count stays 884; reproduced in two independent exports at 31 and 8 threads (43dfd7ec).
